releases.body:
`wait_for` can now wait on more than log tails and process exits.

## Added

- **Unified `condition` parameter** with 11 condition types:
  - files: `file_exists`, `file_absent`, `file_changed`, `file_contains`
  - processes: `process_exited`, `process_running`
  - ports: `port_open`, `port_closed`
  - HTTP: `http_status`, `http_json`, `http_body_contains`
- Condition results expose `metadata.attempts` and the last `metadata.observed` state. A timeout remains a normal result (`hit: false`, `reason: "timeout"`) instead of an error.
- README documentation for every condition type, with CI, registry, port, and file examples.

## Changed

- All project text — README, tool descriptions, error messages, tests, CI workflows, and the release script — translated to English.

## Contributors

- [@masterjg](https://github.com/masterjg) (Marius Guščius) — unified conditions ([#1](https://github.com/lcssos/opencode-wait-for-v2/pull/1)) and English translation ([#2](https://github.com/lcssos/opencode-wait-for-v2/pull/2)).

## Install

```bash
opencode plugin add opencode-wait-for-v2
```

Full changelog: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/lcssos/opencode-wait-for-v2/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
